subject: English
stimulus: (a) But for your timely intervention ⎯⎯. (b) Many days passed ⎯⎯. (c) A child ⎯⎯ is afraid of fire. (d) Work hard provided that ⎯⎯. (e) Blessing is not valued ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) But for your timely intervention I could not have solved the problem. (b) Many days passed since we had met each other. (c) A child which is burnt is afraid of fire. (d) Work hard provided that you want to succeed in life. (e) Blessing is not valued till it is gone.
